title: Pool item
description: One durable work item of the Pool, at pool/records/item/<task_id>.json. It describes work, never a persistent agent, and never assumes that its work has a worktree. This file also holds the definitions shared by every Pool record. See spec/pool.md.

clone_id.description: Given only where the work is bound to one registered clone. The Pool never requires it and never assumes a worktree from it.

body.description: The item's notes, kept exactly as written.

deliverable.description: What a generation of this item produces. Absent until intake assigns it. decision never dispatches.

class.description: The dispatch class, 0 to 7, as the design numbers them. Absent until intake assigns it.

placement_requested.description: The place requested for this item's work. Recorded here, rendered into the Imperative's Setup, resolved by policy at a later stage.

delivery.description: The item's delivery axes, declared separately: validation, publication and Assimilation authority. Absent until intake declares them.

specification_required.description: True when build dispatch needs an accepted specification revision. Absent means false.

specification.description: The accepted specification revision whose criteria this item carries. Set by hive-spec accept and cleared by an invalidation.

schedule.description: A not-before gate or a recurrence as declared on the item. The item owns the work; the dispatcher's scheduled-job record, a later stage's, carries the schedule's runs. A date here dispatches nothing by itself.

generations.description: Every execution generation opened on this item, in order, numbered from 1. At most one is open at a time.

handoff.description: Where a parent routed this item's work to a child Fleet: the one handoff, kept here instead of a second competing task.

legacy.description: For an item imported from a legacy backlog: its legacy identity and the migration that created it. Legacy words are kept here verbatim and never interpreted as authority.

kind.description: The legacy kind word as written, such as SHIP or SCOUT.

repo.description: The legacy repo tag as written.

meta.description: The legacy free-form fields, kept exactly.

closed_at.description: When the item reached done. Cleared on reopen.

legacy_id.description: A legacy backlog identifier, as the upstream grammar accepts it.

text.description: Text kept exactly as written, never empty.

zoned_time.description: A wall-clock time in a declared zone: the UTC instant and the zone's name, as spec/records.md requires.

date.description: The calendar date as it was written where the source gave only a date, as a legacy hold does.

placement.description: mac: on the Mac. claude-cloud-session: in a Claude cloud session. policy: left to the policy resolver. codex-void: Codex in the Void, a named value that admission refuses while the backend is parked.

item_state.description: queued, in-flight and done are the three legacy sections. archived is a retired item, never deleted.

definition_state.description: not-required: no specification is needed. needed, defining, accepted: the design's definition passage. With state, the design's five-step passage reads: definition-needed and defining are queued items in those definition states, accepted is a queued item with an accepted specification, building is in-flight and delivered is done.

validation_axis.description: synapse: Synapse on the Mac validates the result. direct: an explicitly authorized direct delivery with its stated checks.

publication_axis.description: harvest: a Harvest is published. local-only: a local branch, with no forge binding and no invented Harvest.

assimilation_axis.description: word: the Hive Mind's explicit word at landing. posture: a recorded autonomous posture for the project, checked at landing by a later stage.

dependency.description: An edge to another item of the same Pool. blocked-by keeps the item out of ready while its blocker is queued or in-flight; a blocker that is done, or archived after it was done, no longer blocks. reason is free text carried across a round trip and never read for state.

link.description: A typed link: a Harvest by full URL, a report or document by URL or home-relative path, or a Hive record by reference.

kind.description: gate: a one-time not-before time. recurrence: a period and its anchor.

interval.description: An ISO 8601 duration of whole units, such as P1D or PT6H.

anchor.description: The wall-clock time the recurrence keeps across a daylight-saving change.

criteria_ref.description: A specification revision bound by identity, revision and digest. The Imperative's Standard renders criteria from the revision named here and holds no editable copy.

secret_ref.description: A durable reference to a secret: the store it lives in, the host it is for, the account identity and the purpose, and nothing else. It is neither the value nor a transferable authorization: holding one grants nothing, and the value is retrieved from the store at run time by whoever is entitled to it. No Pool record ever holds a secret value; where one must name a secret it holds this.

store.description: The platform's secret store, keychain on the Mac.

host.description: The host the secret is for.

account.description: The account identity the secret belongs to.

purpose.description: What the secret is used for, in words.

generation_entry.description: One execution generation as the Pool knows it: opened before launch with the place requested and the Imperative and admission it runs under, closed with the evidence named. Execution state belongs to the dispatcher's record.

opened_by.description: The request, receipt or record that opened it, where the caller gave one.

placement_requested.description: The item's requested place at the moment the generation opened.

closed_by.description: The receipt or record that establishes the generation's end, as the caller named it.

outcome.description: As the closing caller reported it from its own receipts. unknown is an outcome, never a success.

hold_kind.description: word: held for the Hive Mind's decision. admission: held by an admission check. definition: held until a required specification is accepted. parked, external, resource, future: as the legacy kinds parked, external, load and a dated hold.

item_selector.description: One item by identity, or a query. A query that matches nothing returns an empty list; an identity that does not exist is not_found.

ready.description: True: only items that are queued, not blocked and not actively held.
